thesis: Delivered demand is strong enough to keep Amazon eligible for research, but the evidence does not establish that investment earns adequate owner returns at the current price. Positive trend evidence and negative cash evidence remain unresolved rather than canceling into a confident purchase.
strongest_counterexample: Operating margin improved to 13.9%, AWS grew 39.3%, and price remains above both SMA50 and SMA200; these are real operating and market positives rather than spending alone.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy after reported trailing-year FCF turns positive and total debt does not rise against the current observation.
Reconsider toward sell if AWS revenue growth turns negative in two consecutive reports while trailing-year FCF remains negative.
evidence_gaps: Bridge from investment outflow to sustainable owner cash generation.
Complete liquidity, debt-maturity and financing commitments.
decisive_factors: Operating margin and cloud demand improved.
No authenticated valuation or investment-return bridge.
